label: prop:recursive-atom-knot-atlas
title: Recursive atom-knot atlas at $q_0$ — particles to atoms via Markov-NF braids and hyperbolic-knot closures
html:
Atlas (recursive, q_0-indexed). Each confined particle or atom is identified by the Markov-equivalence class of the closure \widehat{T_w} of its canonical Hecke element:

[K]_M \;=\; \bigl[\,\widehat{T_w}\,\bigr], \qquad T_w \in H_{n_0}(q_0), \quad w \in B_{n_0},

with confinement at q_0 certified by the confinement SDP and each entry fixed by the confinement source of truth. The registry is recursive: composite entries are assembled from nucleon and \alpha-cluster constituents, giving uniform comparison against the AME 2020 reference.

The methodology classification, notation legend, braid-closure gallery, the per-level atlas (\ell = 0 leptons/quarks through \ell = 2 \alpha-cluster atoms), and the per-element AME 2020 cross-reference (Z = 1 to 118) are recorded in the atlas registry.
